about: Starter files Settings → Setup offers a repository on the games list (0.89.0, docs/design-record.md, Setup). Each is written only when the person saw it whole and pressed Write, only where its path is free, and never over a file. `present` says how the Companion knows the repository already has one: `changelog` is any CHANGELOG.md up to three folders down (as the tool kit's changes finds them); `file` is the path itself. A starter `forAgents` is offered only while the features for AI agent sessions are shown.

starters.content:
# Changelog

What changed in each version, newest first. Each version is a heading such as `## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-25`, with sections such as `### Added`, `### Changed` and `### Fixed`, and one entry per line starting with `- `. Work not released yet goes under Unreleased. Commit a change with its entry, in one commit.
